description: Per-page budgets for the browser stage. 'bytes' is the decoded payload of every response a page load causes, 'requests' counts those responses, and 'longestTaskMs' is the longest main-thread block, taken as the larger of the PerformanceObserver long-task entries the engine reports and the longest gap between animation frames. Budgets are today's measurements plus a small margin; raise one only with a recorded reason.
